ready.title: Config ready
ready.description: This page has loaded the global audio configuration from settings.

profile_not_configured.title: No audio profile selected
profile_not_configured.description: Choose a global audio profile for this audio task in settings.

connection_missing.title: Connection missing
connection_missing.description: The model connection referenced by this audio profile no longer exists.

model_missing.title: Model ID missing
model_missing.description: This audio profile is missing the model ID required by this task.

unsupported_capability.title: Capability mismatch
unsupported_capability.description: The selected audio profile does not support this task.

transcriber.title: Audio to text
transcriber.description: Process local audio with the global ASR configuration.

speech.title: Text to audio
speech.description: Generate audio with the global TTS configuration.

captions.title: Realtime captions
captions.description: Process microphone input with the global realtime caption configuration.

voice.title: Duplex voice
voice.description: Start a voice session with OpenAI Realtime configuration.

hints.mimo_response_format: MiMo ASR supports JSON or plain text output in the first version.
hints.openai_response_format: OpenAI Audio supports JSON, plain text, and subtitle formats depending on the model.
hints.timestamps: Timestamps are enabled only for OpenAI verbose JSON output; MiMo docs do not expose this capability.
hints.prompt: Use this for names, product terms, or domain context. MiMo ASR does not support prompts.
hints.stream: File streaming transcription and realtime captions are separate capabilities.
hints.stream_disabled: The first file transcription page uses the non-streaming path; use Realtime Captions for microphone captions.
hints.output_mode: Source or custom folders write the transcript file when the task completes.

placeholders.prompt: Names, product terms, glossary, or domain context
placeholders.mimo_prompt_disabled: The current MiMo ASR mode does not support prompts

file.title: Choose an audio file
file.openai_description: Supports wav, mp3, m4a, mp4, flac, ogg, and webm. Recommended under 25MB.
file.mimo_description: MiMo ASR only accepts wav / mp3 and must stay under 10MB after Base64 encoding.

empty.title: Waiting for audio
empty.description: Choose a file and confirm the settings. The transcript will appear here.
empty.running_description: The request is using the current global audio configuration. Keep this page open.

errors.title: Transcription failed
errors.file_path_unavailable: Could not read the local path for this file. Choose it again inside the Electron app.
errors.unsupported_file: This audio format is not supported.
errors.unsupported_file_for_mimo: MiMo ASR currently supports only wav or mp3 files.
errors.file_too_large: The audio file exceeds the size limit for the current protocol.
errors.output_dir_required: Select an output folder before using custom folder mode.
errors.output_not_ready: There is no output file to open yet.
errors.copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy the result manually.

hints.mimo_voice: Preset voice mode uses voice; voice design does not, and voice clone uses reference audio.
hints.openai_voice: OpenAI voice can be typed manually; presets are only shortcuts.
hints.mimo_format: MiMo non-streaming output is fixed to WAV. Streaming is fixed to PCM16 and saved as WAV when complete.
hints.openai_format: OpenAI official TTS supports multiple binary audio formats.
hints.speed: OpenAI-only option. It is disabled for MiMo and will not enter the payload.
hints.stream: All three MiMo TTS modes use the low-latency PCM16 streaming path.
hints.stream_disabled: The current global audio config does not support MiMo streaming TTS.
hints.stream_on: Streaming plays PCM16 chunks as they arrive, then switches to the final file.
hints.stream_off: Non-streaming waits for the full audio response before playback.
hints.output_mode: Temporary files can be played; custom folders write directly to the selected folder.
hints.mimo_mode: The mode must match the current global TTS model in settings.
hints.voice_design: Voice design requires a description of the voice you want.
hints.voice_clone: Voice clone requires a wav or mp3 reference audio file. File contents are read only in the main process.
hints.audio_tags: Audio tags can be enabled for MiMo preset voice mode. Other modes disable them.
hints.input: Text to synthesize. MiMo voice design may leave this empty when optimizing preview text.

placeholders.mimo_voice: mimo_default / 冰糖 / Mia / custom voice id
placeholders.style_instruction: For example: softer, narrator-like, natural pacing
placeholders.voice_design_prompt: For example: young, bright, friendly female voice
placeholders.instructions: For example: keep a calm tone for podcast narration
placeholders.instructions_mimo_disabled: For MiMo, use the style instruction or voice design prompt on the left

voice_sample.title: Choose reference audio
voice_sample.description: Used only for voice clone mode. Supports wav / mp3.

empty.title: Waiting for text
empty.description: Enter text and confirm settings. The player will appear when generation completes.
empty.running_description: The request is using the current global audio configuration. Keep this page open.

errors.title: Generation failed
errors.output_dir_required: Select an output folder before using custom folder mode.
errors.mimo_model_mismatch: The current mode does not match the global TTS model. Select {{model}} in settings.
errors.voice_design_prompt_required: Voice design mode requires a voice description.
errors.voice_sample_required: Voice clone mode requires reference audio.
errors.output_not_ready: There is no output file to open yet.
errors.voice_sample_path_unavailable: Could not read the local path for the reference audio. Choose it again inside the Electron app.
errors.unsupported_voice_sample: Reference audio supports only wav or mp3.
errors.voice_sample_too_large: Reference audio exceeds the MiMo Base64 size limit.

hints.language: OpenAI Realtime can receive a language preference. Auto detect omits the language field.
hints.input_audio_format: The first version prefers PCM16. Opus depends on the current Realtime model and browser support.
hints.turn_detection: Server VAD detects speech turns automatically. Manual mode is useful for later duplex voice controls.
hints.output_format: TXT saves plain text. SRT uses local session time to generate a basic timeline.
hints.assistant_transcript: Realtime captions show microphone input by default.
hints.assistant_transcript_detail: If the model returns assistant-side transcripts, this toggle shows them.
hints.instructions: Constrain the realtime caption session, such as transcribe only and do not answer.

placeholders.instructions: For example: only transcribe user speech, do not generate replies.
placeholders.instructions_disabled: Realtime instructions are unavailable outside OpenAI Realtime mode

chunked.title: Chunked near-realtime
chunked.description: This mode encodes microphone input into short WAV chunks and lets the main process transcribe each chunk with the global ASR config. It is not a WebRTC duplex session.

empty.title: Waiting for microphone input
empty.description: Starting will request microphone permission and show realtime captions here.
empty.running_description: Start speaking and partial/final captions will appear here.

errors.title: Realtime captions failed
errors.unsupported_mode: The current global audio config does not support realtime captions.
errors.chunked_unavailable: The current global audio config cannot start chunked near-realtime captions.
errors.copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy the captions manually.

hints.voice: The response voice used by OpenAI Realtime duplex voice.
hints.turn_detection: Server VAD detects when the user has finished speaking. Manual mode is for later fine-grained controls.
hints.input_audio_format: Audio format sent from the microphone to the Realtime session.
hints.output_audio_format: Audio format returned by the model remote track.
hints.instructions: Set the assistant speaking style, language, and task boundaries.

placeholders.instructions: For example: answer briefly in Chinese with a natural tone.
placeholders.instructions_disabled: The current config does not support Realtime/WebRTC duplex voice

unsupported.title: Current config does not support duplex voice
unsupported.description: Duplex voice requires an OpenAI Realtime profile with realtime_duplex_voice capability. MiMo Chat Audio only exposes chunked captions and streaming TTS in the first version, so it is not labeled as WebRTC duplex.

empty.title: Waiting for a voice session
empty.description: Connecting will request microphone permission and show user/assistant realtime transcripts here.
empty.running_description: Start speaking and user/assistant partial/final transcripts will appear here.

errors.title: Duplex voice failed
errors.unsupported_profile: The current global audio config does not support Realtime/WebRTC duplex voice.
errors.interrupt_failed: Could not send the interrupt command. Check that the session is still connected.
